name: Astor Enerji
verdict: A listed Turkish transformer maker controlled by the Geçgel family.
note: Rating note: front-of-shirt sponsor of Fenerbahçe Tarfin in the EuroLeague and Türkiye Ligi from September 2026. Listed, with Feridun Geçgel holding 62.68% of the votes (astor-enerji-ownership). On 28 September 2026 Astor said the Capital Markets Board's precautionary and freezing measures on the company had been lifted (Paratic, KAP notice 1668403): a financial matter, not a human-rights finding. ON HOLD: proposed 'none', waiting on a maintainer's review.
